description: One page of an account's open DEX offers, with how funded each one is. When to use: To see which DEX offers an account has open and whether each can still execute: before cancelling or replacing offers, or to check how much of an account's open offers its balances back. Prefer another tool: To read the order book of a pair (use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook`) or estimate the cost of a trade (use `/v1/xrpl/slippage`); for the account's balances and trust lines, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary` or `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`. Example: xrpl_account_offers {"address":"rGAs3npYy1VwLPE92kvKvA2QYLR6FSA9n6"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

limit.description: Offers per page: an integer from 10 to 50 (default 20)

marker.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `marker`, for the same address

name: xrpl_account_offers

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

checks_failed.description: Reads that failed, each leaving the offers it affects with funded_ratio (or expired) null: `account`, `lines`, `issuer:<address>`, `ledger`, `reserves`; empty when none failed

marker.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (send as `marker`); null on the last page

offers.description: Open DEX offers of this page, in the ledger's order

buys.description: What the offer buys (TakerPays); XRP in XRP, not drops; an MPT in `value_atomic`

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`: XRP in XRP, not drops; an issued currency as the ledger holds it; null for an MPT, since this route reads no MPT issuance and so no `AssetScale` (its base units are in `value_atomic`)

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

expired.description: True when the Expiration is at or before the validated ledger close time; false without an Expiration; null when that close time could not be read

expires_at.description: Expiration of the offer, ISO 8601 UTC; null when the offer has none

funded_ratio.description: min(1, available / sells), per offer (offers sharing a balance are not netted): available is spendable XRP (balance minus reserve) for XRP, or the line balance divided by the issuer TransferRate / 1e9 for a token; 1 when the account issues the token it sells; 0 when the issuer froze the line or all its tokens, when the line of the bought token is deep-frozen by its issuer, or when a complete lines page holds no line for the token; null for an MPT, when the line may lie beyond the lines page read, when the issuer is beyond the first 10 distinct issuers of the page, or when a read it needs failed (see checks_failed)

hybrid.description: lsfHybrid: the offer sits in a permissioned domain's book and in the open book

passive.description: lsfPassive: the offer does not consume offers that exactly match it

price.description: What the offer buys / what it sells (XRP in XRP, not drops): units of `buys.asset` per unit of `sells.asset`, an MPT side in its base units (`value_atomic`, no issuance read); null when sells is zero

sell.description: lsfSell: the offer exchanges all of sells even when it gets more than buys

sells.description: What the offer sells (TakerGets); XRP in XRP, not drops; an MPT in `value_atomic`

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`: XRP in XRP, not drops; an issued currency as the ledger holds it; null for an MPT, since this route reads no MPT issuance and so no `AssetScale` (its base units are in `value_atomic`)

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

seq.description: Sequence number of the transaction that created the offer

unfunded.description: Offers on this page with funded_ratio 0

title: XRPL account offers
